{{Quote|Let's see how the shuttle's doing. Come and do your trick with the transponder, chum.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], to the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Benb]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
A '''replenishment shuttle''' was aboard the ''[[Leveler]]'', used by a small strike force to [[Battle of JanFathal|rescue]] [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Hallena Devis]] from [[JanFathal]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
